prompt: A farming village that feeds my base.

card.name: Harvest Hamlet

site.text: A farming village on gentle, open ground with room for fields around it

style.text: Warm, homely rural look: timber, thatch-like roofs, hay, flower boxes, lanterns

purpose.text: A farming village that feeds the player's base

card.interpretation: A small, medium-sized rustic farming village on flat land within the 64-block claim, with homes, barns, a mill and a central granary that stores food for your base. Farm fields surround the buildings, so the layout is spread out.
assumptions: Size M, as none was given
Rustic style, as a fitting default for farming
Low density to leave room for fields
Placement is searched, as no spot was named
Difficulty is patron, the world default

program.notes: Large storage hall with chests of crops and a loading area where food is collected for the base.
Farmers' homes with beds, a small kitchen garden and a chest.
Hay, seed and tool storage beside the fields.
Cows, sheep, pigs and chickens in fenced pens.
Mill grinds wheat; bakery makes bread. Stands by water if any.
Village well with a produce stall.
